story.lore.l07.title: Thirty Days
story.lore.l07.body:
Temporary governor designation: Warden Shen Heng.
Purpose: hold the closed cycle while both spillways are cleared and inspected.
Maximum duration: thirty days.

A transfer test must be completed before renewal. No extension may be inferred from silence or from the continued operation of the array.

Shen Heng: I understand that my Core will sustain the governor during this interval. I consent to the interval stated above. I do not consent to an indefinite bond.

Witness: junior surveyor Yun.

Below the signatures, the release field is clean. It has never held an imprint.
story.lore.l08.title: Renewal, Year Four
story.lore.l08.body:
The governor remains within operating limits. Downstream demand has been reclassified as seasonal. Replacement work is deferred pending coordinated staffing.

Consent confirmation: no response returned by the bound governor.

Recommendation: continue the present protective arrangement until a responsible successor can be identified.

Margin in a different hand: We have asked for a successor, not for workers to repair the arrangement. Those are different requests.

The margin was crossed out once. It is still readable beneath the line.
story.lore.l08.date: Fourth year after the White Tide
story.lore.l09.title: Release Valve Diagram
story.lore.l09.body:
Blue path: intake from Bamboo buffer.
White path: cooled return to valley.
Red path: emergency diversion through governor.

The red path is narrow because it is temporary. When the white path is obstructed, do not widen the red path as a permanent correction. Heat readings may improve while the governor load worsens.

Inspection order: return outlet, heat sink, intake needle. Never read the intake alone.

A later addition covers the white line with a seal. Under that seal, its inspection date has been left blank.
story.lore.l10.title: An Unsent Survey
story.lore.l10.body:
The winter correction is not reducing excess. It is reducing delivery to the floodplain so that the mountain's gauge remains quiet.

I wrote "stable" in six annual reports because the needle did not cross its mark. I did not measure what the lower channels had lost. The tables rewarded the first answer and had no column for the second.

That is an account of how I missed it, not a reason you should excuse me.

I will take the next reading below the gates. Leave this beside the old reports; it belongs with them.

— Yun
story.lore.l11.title: A Guardian's Maintenance Request
story.lore.l11.body:
The right arm of the defensive shell will not lower while a pressure alarm is active. Please do not send an attendant to stand in its reach.

I can still hear commands addressed to the governor. The command to release me is not reaching the binding.

This is the third request. If repair is delayed, remove the spearhead. It serves no function at a valve.

I cannot sign a handover I have not been allowed to read.

— Shen Heng

The reply field contains only: Routine component inspection scheduled.
story.lore.l11.date: Second year after the White Tide
story.lore.l12.title: The Evacuation Route
story.lore.l12.body:
If the mountain intake must be retired, the lower river can still feed the western terrace through the old branch. Two houses will have to move before winter. Their owners have asked who will carry the stone hearths. Tell them we will.

Do not write "relocation complete" while their rooms are empty and their belongings are still on the bank.

This route is a fallback, not proof that the valley no longer needs water. If a safer open cycle can be verified, use it. If it cannot, choosing a smaller sanctuary is better than disguising another person as a replacement part.

— Yun
